response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt, COUNT(*) as num_groups FROM group_counts), shares AS (SELECT g.link_to_major, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_cnt as share, 1.0 / t.num_groups as avg_share FROM group_counts g, total t), above_avg AS (SELECT * FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_members_in_above_average, AVG(share) as average_share_of_above_average, AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess FROM above_avg

assumptions.assumption: Members with NULL in link_to_major form a single distinct group, treated identically to groups with non-NULL major values in all calculations (totals, shares, comparisons)
